entries.name: compost-tea
entries.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: square product illustration for a French farming game, drawn from actual retailer product photos. Redraw the referenced real product packaging as a realistic fine sepia ink and watercolor illustration: carefully observed proportions, delicate pen hatching, subtle natural watercolor textures and soft volume. It MUST visibly be hand-drawn, not a photograph. Plain warm ivory background #f8f2e4, soft subtle grounded shadow, centered with 12% margins, no frame. Preserve real container shapes, caps, materials, brand colours and placement of primary label names faithfully. Small-print details can be simplified into discreet ink strokes. No extra marketing claims, no UI, no retailer watermark or website text, no unrelated decorative objects. Reference image 1 is the actual Terralba compost-tea ingredients pack sold by Alchimia, and defines the objects. Reproduce the compact still-life grouping of the open shallow kraft box with transparent labelled small pouches, the dark small bottle, two tall transparent pouches containing chopped dried botanical ingredients behind, and the dark compost pouch in front. All are in this ONE drawing. Keep the characteristic white labels with green-black Terralba emblem. Do not add a glass tea jug, tea cup, brewing machine or fabricated container. Reference is packaging appearance only; no instructions or measurements in the image.
